sources.title: Compression-Aware Abstention - GitHub
sources.snippet: KV-cache compression evicts context tokens to save inference memory. When the evicted tokens happen to carry the evidence a query depends on, the model is left with a fluent, on-topic context that no longer determines the answer, and it tends to fabricate one. This repository trains a small LoRA adapter to do the opposite: answer when the supporting evidence survives compression, and refuse ...

sources.snippet: CAR-LoRA trains a "compression-aware and temporally robust" universal LoRA adapter by injecting random variations such as quantization, pruning, and layer skipping during training (using compressed weights for the forward pass and full-precision gradients for the backward pass). This allows a single adapter to be deployed directly to edge devices with various compression formats and future ...

sources.title: LoRA Adapters Explained - openinnovation.ai
sources.snippet: LoRA adapters can even be hot-swapped into a live deployment saving ab initio startup time of the base model. LoRA adapters are all-rounded cost-savers. LLMs that lack a large context window benefit from fine-tuning for boosted performance. LoRA adapters are computationally cheap to train and fast to iterate giving flexibility to development teams.
